```

  --model <model> --effort <effort> --background --brief <brief-file>
```

6. **Arm the unattended guards.** 45 minutes is past the 30-minute line, so read `~/.claude/docs/unattended-work-guards.md` and arm it before launch. I haven't read that doc in this session.
7. **Write the brief for a reader with no context.** Include the 640px breakpoint, the two files, the 375px check, and both done items copied from the spec.
